coverage: Complete novel in both English editions: named cast and references, reviewed recognizable unnamed roles, historical diners, and source-gated returns and imposture exclusions.

entities.name: Candide
entities.body: The young Westphalian man whose travels the novel follows, raised in the baron’s household.

entities.name: Cunegonde
entities.body: The baron’s daughter and Candide’s beloved.

snapshots.body: Candide’s wife, the baron’s daughter he has long loved.

entities.name: Pangloss

snapshots.body: Cunegonde’s elderly servant and traveling companion.
